req.title: Create new player
req.statement: The system shall create a player and respond with HTTP 201 when POST /players/ receives a valid Player payload.
expected_outcomes: Location header points to new resource

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates HTTP 201 on valid POST /players/ with a Location header. Tests cover: (1) EP positive — a fully-populated valid payload with a new squad number returns 201 and correct Location; (2) EP positive minimal — only required fields supplied; (3) NEG duplicate squad number returns 409; (4) NEG missing required field returns 422; (5) BVA squad number boundary at 27 (first unused) vs 26 (last pre-loaded, duplicate); (6) DT — all optional fields null/absent still creates successfully; (7) STC — response body fields match the submitted payload exactly, catching field-mapping mutations; (8) NEG — completely empty body returns 422. Each test imports the app in-process and uses TestClient, asserting exact status codes and header values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_create_player_valid_full_payload_returns_201
preconditions: Database contains exactly 26 pre-loaded players (squad numbers 1-26)
actions: POST /players/ with a fully-populated valid PlayerRequestModel payload using squad_number=27
expected: Response body contains id (UUID), first_name, last_name, squad_number=27, position
trace: R-PLAYER-006: system shall respond HTTP 201 when POST /players/ receives a valid Player payload
R-PLAYER-006: Location header points to new resource
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_player_valid_full_payload_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "middleName": "Mid",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "dateOfBirth": "1990-06-15T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 27,
        "position": "Goalkeeper",
        "abbrPosition": "GK",
        "team": "Test FC",
        "league": "Test League",
        "starting11": True
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert r.headers["location"] == "/players/squadnumber/27"
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 27
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert body["starting11"] is True
    assert "id" in body

tests.name: test_create_player_location_header_exact_format
actions: Inspect Location header for exact path format
expected: Location header is exactly /players/squadnumber/31 (not /players/31 or any other format)
trace: R-PLAYER-006: Location header points to new resource at /players/squadnumber/{squad_number}
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_player_location_header_exact_format():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Location",
        "lastName": "Header",
        "squadNumber": 31,
        "position": "Central Midfield"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    location = r.headers["location"]
    assert location == "/players/squadnumber/31"
    assert location != "/players/31"
    assert location != "/players/squadnumber/30"
    assert location != "/players/squadnumber/32"
